profiles.stockfish: upstream built-in fixed-depth bench; bind benchmark.cpp, source revision, executable, NNUE, options and actual variable node workload
profiles.cutechess: paired-color Stockfish self-play with ponder disabled, fixed game depth and maximum moves; bind PGN and process identities

resources.cpu: minimum of caller affinity and every visible ancestor CPU quota; preserve fractional CPU equivalence
resources.memory: minimum of MemAvailable and every visible ancestor memory.max minus memory.current
resources.game_cpu: concurrency times threads per active engine with ponder off
resources.game_memory: two resident engines per game times Hash plus explicit overhead estimate; enforce sampled RSS ceiling
resources.hidden_ancestors: unobservable; never claim whole physical host capacity

recommendation: only best measured configuration for this input, execution environment and resource grant; elapsed-workload and aggregate-game throughput remain separate
forbidden_claims: fixed-depth SMP does identical node work
compiled huge-page support proves actual allocation
tool availability proves Laplace chess or Lichess service capability
